about_the_game:
We thought progress would save us. It ended us.

In 1945, the world gained the power to erase cities. By the 1960s, thermonuclear bombs could flatten entire regions. But it wasn’t enough. Project S.U.N.D.I.A.L. was the final step - a classified superweapon capable of destroying entire continents. It was never meant to be used. Until the day - night turned to day. Thousands of suns rose from the earth. A blinding flash. Silence. Then the shockwave - a force that erased everything in its path.

 

No one knows if it was sabotage, accident, or madness. Only what followed: billions dead, governments collapsing, the world broken - and the birth of the Zone. Twisted. Something came through when the fabric of reality tore. They are called Hollows - not much is known, except that they don’t belong here.

The last remaining governments sealed it off. Too dangerous. They abandoned it - but they still pay handsomely for the secrets of the Zone.

 

Key Features

  • High-Stakes Hardcore PvPvE Combat                                                                                 

    Outsmart enemies both human and non-human as you sneak or shoot your way through roaming mutated wildlife, ruthless raider or the hollows. Encounter other players in the lawless wastes. Are you going to cooperate with other players for mutual survival or betray them for a chance at priceless loot? Every expedition is high tension, where betrayal can strike at any moment.

  • Extraction Tension                                                                                                                     

    Get in, grab what you can, and extract before it’s too late. But nothing is easy in this postapocalyptic world. Die, and you lose everything you’re carrying. Survive, and you keep your hard-won loot to fight another day. Each run is a high-risk gambling. How much will you wager on your life?

  • Hardcore Survival Mechanics                                                                                           

    Endure a true survival challenge with realistic body part damage simulation. Get shot in the leg and you’ll struggle to move or bleed out if you forgot your bandages. Head wounds blur vision, cause confusion, or most likely ends you on the spot. Handle radiation exposure, toxins, hunger, thirst, heat, cold and much more.

  • Procedural Maps                                                                                                                     

    No two raids are alike. Project S.U.N.D.I.A.L blends handcrafted locations with procedurally generated layouts, creating an ever-changing 2D battlefield where danger is both scripted and unpredictable. Explore derelict cities, toxic wilderness, and buried bunkers, caves and all shifting under dynamic weather and seasonal cycles that can turn a simple run into a brutal fight for survival.

  • Gun Customization: 

    Arm yourself with an unparalleled weapon customization system. Every firearm is a canvas for modification, featuring up to 15 interchangeable parts. Swap barrels, stocks, scopes, triggers, and more to forge a weapon that suits your playstyle. Craft the best weapons of which you can think of!

  • Anomalies  

    Unstable rifts that tear open without warning, twisting the laws of nature. Some burn your skin just by being near, others warp gravity or corrode machines where they stand. Anomalies are unpredictable: they might kill you, disorient you, or reveal things no one was meant to see. Yet for those who take the risk, they can hide powerful items, rare resources, and secrets worth dying for. Every encounter is a gamble — step away, or step in and discover what lies beyond.

  • You are what your wear 

    Your appearance changes with the armor you equip. Judge an NPC or player’s strength by their gear, and guess what loot they might drop if you win. Is the risk worth the reward?

  • Quests, Bosses & Events

    Each match is more than loot and extraction. While you scavenge, events unfold in real time: a distress signal, a fallen drone, or a raider ambush. Some lead to rare loot. Others to death. Powerful Bosses roam the map like mutants, cannibals, hollows and much more. What you going when you face them? Run for you life or try to get super rare gear? What’s more worth?

  • The Hideout & Crafting

    In Project S.U.N.D.I.A.L, crafting is deep, flexible, and essential. You can ignore it… but how long will you last without bullets, armor, or meds? Smelt ores in the refinery. Craft armor in the workshop. Not satisfied? Recycle and recover materials to try again. Build a Gamer Room to help survivors reduce stress - or play a few games yourself. Hit the Gym to toughen up for the wasteland. Expand your hideout with farms, storage, lab and much more. Assign survivors to roles like mechanic, doctor, cook, or farmer - each offering unique skills and bonuses. They’ll work for you… if you keep them breathing.

  • Dynamic Weather & Seasons:

    Every map shifts with time - visit the same location in winter and you’ll find new paths, different enemies, unique quests, and NPCs who only appear under certain conditions. But the weather doesn’t just change the world - it changes how you survive. Don’t walk into a snowstorm in rags. Don’t wear a bomb suit in the desert sun.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: OS: Windows 7 SP1 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E4500 or AMD Athlon 64 X2 5600+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD 3000 or equivalent at least 256 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU such as NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 or AMD Radeon R5 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: Online PvPvE extraction shooter with hardcore survival mechanics. Explore the wastelands of France, the dark forests of Eastern Europe, and Norway's infamous Hollow Plague Fjord — and beyond. Face off against rival players, ruthless raiders, and the terrifying Hollows.
